mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,nrmp_nivel as level ,drmp_fechainicio as startDate ,drmp_fechafin as endDate ,crmp_periodo as period ,nrmp_ano as year ,nrmp_mes as month ,nrmp_dia as day ,nrmp_hora as hour ,nrmp_minuto as minute ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,drmp_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crmp_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crmp_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drmp_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crmp_estado as state from x_${catalog}_${type}_rmp inner join cuenta_cue on (ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta)
mapper.select: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,nrmp_nivel as level ,drmp_fechainicio as startDate ,drmp_fechafin as endDate ,crmp_periodo as period ,nrmp_ano as year ,nrmp_mes as month ,nrmp_dia as day ,nrmp_hora as hour ,nrmp_minuto as minute ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,drmp_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crmp_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crmp_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drmp_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crmp_estado as state from account.cuenta_cue left join account.mapa_resultados_rmp on (crmp_cuenta = ccue_llave and nrmp_nivel = 0) where ccue_catalogo = '${catalogId}' and ncue_nivel = 1 and ccue_estado = 'A' and (crmp_tipo is null or crmp_tipo = 'P') order by ccue_wbs

select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_catalogo as catalog ,crmp_cuenta as account ,nrmp_nivel as level ,drmp_fechainicio as startDate ,drmp_fechafin as endDate ,crmp_periodo as period ,nrmp_ano as year ,nrmp_mes as month ,nrmp_dia as day ,nrmp_hora as hour ,nrmp_minuto as minute ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_tipo as type from account.mapa_resultados_rmp where crmp_cuenta = '${accountId}' and (nrmp_nivel = 0 or (nrmp_nivel = 1 and nrmp_ano = ${year}) or (nrmp_nivel = 2 and nrmp_ano = ${year} and nrmp_mes = ${month}) or (nrmp_nivel = 3 and nrmp_ano = ${year} and nrmp_mes = ${month} and nrmp_dia = ${day}) or (nrmp_nivel = 4 and nrmp_ano = ${year} and nrmp_mes = ${month} and nrmp_dia = ${day} and nrmp_hora = ${hour}) or (nrmp_nivel = 5 and nrmp_ano = ${year} and nrmp_mes = ${month} and nrmp_dia = ${day} and nrmp_hora = ${hour} and nrmp_minuto = ${minute}) )

update account.mapa_resultados_rmp set drmp_modificacionfecha = now(), nrmp_cantidad = #{item.quantity}, nrmp_promedio = #{item.average}, mrmp_positivo = #{item.positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{item.negative}, mrmp_valor = #{item.value} where crmp_llave =#{item.key}

select cuenta.ccue_llave as key ,cuenta.ccue_catalogo as catalog ,cuenta.dcue_fechainicial as initialDate ,cuenta.dcue_fechafinal as finalDate ,ccue_nombre as name from account.cuenta_cue cuenta inner join account.catalogo_ctg catalogo on (catalogo.cctg_llave = cuenta.ccue_catalogo and catalogo.cctg_estado= 'A') where cuenta.ccue_estado = 'A' and ( cuenta.dcue_fechainicial is null or cuenta.dcue_fechafinal is null or cuenta.dcue_fechainicial > catalogo.dctg_fechainicial or cuenta.dcue_fechafinal < catalogo.dctg_fechafinal ) order by cuenta.ccue_wbs limit 500;
